lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into at least six visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of blobs, creating a coordinate-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the upper edge to a deep shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white semi-circular arc or depigmented lesion is visible on the dorsal surface, situated anterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark, high-contrast rectangular feature is visible on the mid-lateral flank, potentially representing an external parasite or attachment.
